queries.sql: SELECT bucket_a._time AS early_window, bucket_a.cnt AS early_cnt, bucket_a.avg_tput AS early_avg_tput, bucket_b._time AS late_window, bucket_b.cnt AS late_cnt, bucket_b.avg_tput AS late_avg_tput FROM (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '3 minutes') AS _time, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(throughput_rate), 2) AS avg_tput FROM "{stream}" WHERE _timestamp < (SELECT MIN(_timestamp) + (MAX(_timestamp) - MIN(_timestamp)) / 2 FROM "{stream}") GROUP BY _time) bucket_a FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '3 minutes') AS _time, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(throughput_rate), 2) AS avg_tput FROM "{stream}" WHERE _timestamp >= (SELECT MIN(_timestamp) + (MAX(_timestamp) - MIN(_timestamp)) / 2 FROM "{stream}") GROUP BY _time) bucket_b ON bucket_a._time = bucket_b._time ORDER BY early_window ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS minute_slot, COUNT(*) AS total_events, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cell_temp >= 28.0 THEN throughput_rate ELSE NULL END), 2) AS avg_tput_hot, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cell_temp < 28.0 THEN throughput_rate ELSE NULL END), 2) AS avg_tput_cool FROM "{stream}" WHERE throughput_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY minute_slot ORDER BY minute_slot ASC

SELECT
  (_timestamp - (_timestamp % 60000000)) AS ts_minute,
  facility_zone,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  AVG(throughput_rate) AS avg_throughput,
  MAX(cell_temp) AS max_temp,
  MIN(charge_remaining) AS min_charge,
  SUM(item_count) AS total_items
FROM "{stream}"
WHERE load_factor > 20.0
  AND throughput_rate >= 100.0
GROUP BY (_timestamp - (_timestamp % 60000000)), facility_zone
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY ts_minute DESC, cnt DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT time_band, facility_zone,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  AVG(throughput_rate) AS avg_throughput
FROM (
  SELECT _timestamp, facility_zone, throughput_rate, load_factor,
    CASE
      WHEN ((_timestamp - MIN(_timestamp) OVER ()) / 60000000) < 60 THEN 'first_minute'
      WHEN ((_timestamp - MIN(_timestamp) OVER ()) / 60000000) < 120 THEN 'second_minute'
      ELSE 'later'
    END AS time_band
  FROM "{stream}"
  WHERE load_factor > 10.0
) sub
GROUP BY time_band, facility_zone
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY time_band, cnt DESC
